# Fixture Permit Handbook

TEST FIXTURE ONLY. Synthetic text written for software tests; it is not part of any real corpus.

## 1 Eligibility

Applicants must be at least 18 years old. Applicants must provide proof of residence.
Applicants who hold a suspended permit cannot apply.

## 2 Application Process

Applications are submitted online through the permit portal. Each application is reviewed by a permit officer.
Applicants receive the decision by post.

## 3 Renewal

Permits must be renewed every 2 years. A renewal can be requested up to 30 days before the permit expires.
